sample_unit: ChatGPT answers (10 fictional vignettes entered 5 times each)

links.outcome: Triage accuracy and potential for harm of ChatGPT answers to ophthalmological emergency vignettes
links.effect: Triage accuracy 93.6%; most prehospital recommendations appropriate, but potential to inflict harm to users/patients present in 32% of answers.
links.quote: However, an overall potential to inflict harm to users/patients was present in 32% of answers.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline triage accuracy and potential for harm on simulated ophthalmological emergency vignettes without testing a deployment guardrail.
